core.title: AgentFold: Closed-Loop Agentic Search for Protein Folding Model Design
core.abstract: Scientific LLM agents have shown promise in literature reasoning, tool use, and experiment planning, but it remains unclear whether they can autonomously improve large, tightly coupled scientific machine-learning systems through executable code changes and computationally expensive validation. We study this question in protein folding, where progress requires coordinated architectural modifications, multi-objective evaluation, and domain-aware interpretation. We present AgentFold, a multi-agent framework that formulates folding-model development as a closed-loop search over executable code variants. Starting from ESMFold, AgentFold proposes hypotheses, implements and debugs code-level modifications, evaluates model variants, analyzes experimental outcomes, and stores both successful and failed interventions in structured memory. An MCTS-style policy allocates computational resources across high-scoring search branches. On an engineering-scale protein-folding codebase comprising more than 2,000 lines of code, AgentFold explores approximately 80 model variants using approximately 5,000 GPU-hours and 170 million LLM tokens. Under a matched computational budget, AgentFold improves the best lDDT by 7.5% over independent Codex proposals and outperforms a random-search control. Beyond model improvement, the resulting intervention traces reveal recurring empirical design patterns: stable gains tend to arise from early, soft, learnable priors and gated refinement, whereas direct geometric perturbations and geometry-conditioned feedback often destabilize training. The code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/lmqfly/AgentFold.
core.summary: AgentFold研究科学智能体能否通过修改、调试和验证代码，自主改进蛋白折叠模型。系统结合MCTS式搜索、实验记忆和多智能体协作，在紧凑ESMFold衍生模型上探索约80个变体。匹配36次评估时，最佳lDDT达到0.285，高于独立Codex提案的0.265。收益主要集中于局部结构，消融支持IPA偏置与更新门控的互补作用。解读：本文更适合作为闭环科研与模型设计方法案例，而非全局折叠能力突破的证据。[P1–P9]

deep_read.problem: 论文关注的不是单次代码生成，而是智能体能否在紧耦合科学模型中完成可执行修改、故障恢复和昂贵实验比较。蛋白折叠同时涉及序列表示、几何精化及多种结构指标，因此研究目标兼顾模型性能与可积累的干预证据，而非仅产生文字假设。[P1–P3]
deep_read.method: 系统以代码快照构建MCTS式搜索树，经采样、去重、统一规划编码、调试、训练及分析完成内循环，数据库保存成败记录。外循环每10次迭代更新评分；NWRS汇总五类指标的均值和中位数，Critic分数仅用于实验优先级，不用于证明最终改进。[P3–P4][P14–P15]
deep_read.innovation: 解读：方法特色在于把通用搜索与智能体组件落实到可执行折叠代码的连续改进，并将失败干预转为后续设计上下文。作者同时提出几何前偏置、乘性精化及避免几何反馈的经验模式；这些来自轨迹归纳，不应包装为新的通用搜索理论或已证明的生物物理规律。[P2–P3][P6][P16]
deep_read.findings: 匹配36次评估时，AgentFold最佳lDDT为0.285，Codex和随机控制器分别为0.265、0.260。最优变体参数增加约1.1%；去除IPA偏置或更新门控使平均lDDT分别下降0.017、0.012。但其平均loop RMSD增加0.041，说明局部准确度收益不等于所有指标改善。[P5][P7–P8][P16]
deep_read.limitations: 作者将主要证据限定于紧凑单块模型、1,000链训练集及CAMEO2022开发评价，向更强模型、多链及其他领域迁移未验证。解读：整体控制器比较未分离各组件贡献，轨迹关联也非因果证明。核对记录未确认原文件缺项；P8异版混入及P13根号问题均为已纠正的提取错误。[P5][P9][P13]
deep_read.connection: 解读：与generative_design的联系主要是生成、实现和筛选模型架构变体，而非直接生成工程构件。失败记忆、预算分配和多目标评价可为智能运维及可靠性研究提供框架借鉴；局部准确度、物理合理性和长程接触的权衡，也提示结构设计不能仅优化单一综合分数。[P3–P4][P16–P17]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：先冻结搜索与训练预算，单独消融记忆、树控制器和Critic，再以独立评价集检验搜索所得收益。若迁移到工程结构设计，应建立可执行设计接口、力学验证与失效约束，并分别报告性能提升和安全退化，避免将蛋白折叠中的经验模式直接当作工程规律。[P5][P9][P14–P17]

core.title: Trip+: Benchmarking Agents in Personalized Interactive Travel Planning
core.abstract: Interactive travel planning has become a popular use case for language models. Agents are deployed to manage evolving preferences and unexpected disruptions over multiple turns. Such settings require models to make complex, profile-conditioned planning decisions. However, existing benchmarks often evaluate feasibility, personalization, or interaction in relatively isolated settings. We therefore introduce Trip+ to measure the ability of agents to plan travel holistically. In Trip+, given traveler profiles and dynamic interactions, agents must generate and revise minute-level itineraries. End-to-end traveler experiences are evaluated via LLM-based simulators, enabling the assessment of subjective metrics like fatigue. Our scenarios range from simple request resolutions to complex environment-driven replanning. We evaluate 18 LMs and find a consistent gap in experiential quality. Models favor technically feasible but exhausting itineraries that show weaker profile alignment.
core.summary: Trip+研究旅行规划智能体如何在需求变化与环境扰动中，同时保持行程可执行、画像适配和历史意图一致。基准包含153个多轮实例、570轮交互，结合固定沙箱、状态化规则及体验模拟评价18个模型。结果提示，较高可行性不代表舒适体验，节奏控制与跨轮修订仍是短板；多数指标的领先差异未获显著性支持。[P2][P6][P37]解读：值得作为动态规划代理的评价方法阅读，但旅游疲劳并非结构疲劳或工程可靠性证据。

core.title: Recontextualizing Famous Quotes for Brand Slogan Generation
core.abstract: Slogans are concise and memorable catchphrases that play crucial roles in advertising by conveying brand identity and shaping public perception. However, advertising fatigue reduces the effectiveness of repeated slogans, creating a growing demand for novel, creative, and insightful slogan generation. While recent work leverages large language models (LLMs) for this task, existing approaches often generate stylistically repetitive outputs that fall short in distinctiveness and insight.We argue that effective slogans should balance novelty with familiarity and propose a new paradigm that recontextualizes persona-related famous quotes for slogan generation. Well-known quotes naturally align with slogan-length text, employ rich rhetorical devices, and offer depth and insight, making them a powerful resource for creative generation. Technically, we introduce a framework that decomposes slogan generation into interpretable subtasks with a single-pass prompt, including quote matching, structural decomposition, vocabulary replacement, and remix generation. Extensive automatic and human evaluations demonstrate marginal improvements in diversity, emotional impact, and first-glance human preference over three state-of-the-art LLM baselines.

core.title: LTS-VoiceAgent: A Listen-Think-Speak Framework for Efficient Streaming Voice Interaction via Semantic Triggering and Incremental Reasoning
core.abstract: Real-time voice agents face a tension: end-to-end models often lack deep reasoning, while cascaded ASR–LLM–TTS pipelines achieve stronger reasoning but defer LLM inference until after ASR finalizes the transcript, creating an avoidable post–turn-end silent gap. We target this gap under complex spoken requests that admit a relatively determinate answer, and treat it as system-induced rather than communicatively motivated. Existing cascaded streaming strategies attempt to reduce it via mechanical segmentation (e.g., fixed chunks, VAD-based splitting) or speculative generation, but they frequently either break semantic units or waste computation on predictions that must be rolled back. We propose LTS-VoiceAgent, a Listen–Think–Speak framework that explicitly separates when to think from how to reason incrementally. It features a Dynamic Semantic Trigger to detect meaningful prefixes, and a Dual-Role Stream Orchestrator that coordinates a background Thinker (for state maintenance) and a foreground Speaker (for speculative solving). This parallel design enables "thinking while listening" without committing audible content before turn end. We also introduce a Pause-and-Repair benchmark that injects natural disfluencies as a semantic-level streaming stress test. Experiments across VERA, Spoken-MQA, BigBenchAudio, and our benchmark show that LTS-VoiceAgent achieves a stronger accuracy–latency–efficiency trade-off than serial cascaded baselines and existing streaming strategies.
core.summary: 复杂语音请求常使级联系统在用户说完后才开始推理，形成明显等待。本文通过语义触发器判断何时值得计算，并让后台Thinker维护状态、前台Speaker准备答案，将部分推理移入收听阶段。[P3—P5] 四个基准显示其在实时预算下改善质量与效率，8B模型首完整句延迟为332—415毫秒，但并未全面超过完整上下文推理。[P7] 解读：适合作为运维语音助手的架构参考，不是已验证的故障诊断或可靠性方法。

deep_read.problem: 本文针对有相对确定答案的复杂口语请求：串行级联等待转录结束才推理，固定分块又可能切断语义，提前猜测则因用户修正而反复回滚。目标是压缩系统造成的轮后静默，不是消除所有会话停顿，也不主张回答越快越好。[P1—P3][P9]
deep_read.method: DistilBERT判断累积转录是否达到语义触发条件，并以阈值和去重过滤无效调用。Thinker维护变量与计划，Speaker并发求解并读取上次已提交状态；新触发抢占旧生成，过时状态丢弃，轮次结束后才提交TTS，避免听见内部回滚。[P4—P5][P13]
deep_read.innovation: 解读：方法贡献主要在于把触发时机与增量推理组织分开，而非首次提出边听边算。作者将学习式语义边界、双角色状态复用和抢占调度组合，并构造含犹豫与自我修正的Pause-and-Repair基准，使输入修订成为显式压力测试。[P6][P12][P19]

core.title: Learning to Remember: End-to-End Training of Memory Agents for Long-Context Reasoning
core.abstract: Long-context LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems expand accessible context, but still defer state tracking and evidence consolidation to query time. This passive paradigm is brittle in streaming settings where facts are updated and answers depend on latent states rather than explicit spans. We introduce Unified Memory Agent (UMA), an end-to-end reinforcement-learning framework that trains a single policy to maintain external memory and answer questions. UMA updates a structured memory bank via CRUD operations and combines it with raw-context retrieval for QA. To jointly optimize memory maintenance and question answering, we propose Task-Stratified GRPO, which normalizes heterogeneous trajectories separately for more effective credit assignment. We also introduce Ledger-QA, a controlled benchmark for long-horizon state tracking over accumulated updates. Experiments on Ledger-QA and 13 TTL/AR benchmarks show that UMA improves long-horizon tracking, achieves the best average TTL/AR score among compared methods, and remains competitive on retrieval-centric benchmarks. Our results highlight learned proactive memory management as a complement to longer context windows and query-time retrieval.
core.summary: 面对持续更新的信息，长上下文模型和RAG往往到提问时才重新整合证据。本文提出统一记忆智能体UMA，在问题揭示前维护结构化记忆，再供多个问答会话复用，并以任务分层GRPO联合训练记忆维护和答案生成。16k预算下，其在13项TTL/AR基准的平均裁判分数领先；账本任务适配进一步改善状态追踪，但超长跨度数值正确性仍弱。[P3–P9、P25]解读：适合作为智能运维状态管理的方法参考，而非直接部署依据。
core.method: 基于原文摘要的规则摘要
core.recommendation: 推荐重点阅读分层信用分配、记忆维护消融和三阶段错误分析，它们可为运维智能体的状态更新与故障归因提供研究思路；但论文没有真实运维任务验证。[P5、P9、P22]

deep_read.problem: 论文研究信息流持续更新时，如何在未知未来问题的条件下保留可复用状态。答案可能来自跨时间累积，而不直接存在于某段原文；逐问检索易重复计算，普通摘要也可能丢失更新细节。核心问题因此是让共享记忆同时服务多个未来目标，而非围绕已知问题压缩上下文。[P1–P3、P6]
deep_read.method: UMA用统一策略处理记忆与问答：逐块维护核心摘要和键值库，通过增删改及读取操作更新状态，问答时结合记忆读取与原文检索。训练采样多条记忆轨迹，以各轨迹下多问答案的平均结果奖励监督记忆，并对记忆会话和逐问题问答组分别归一化优势。[P3–P5]
deep_read.innovation: 创新重点是问题隐藏条件下的共享记忆监督、统一记忆—问答策略与任务分层优势估计的组合，而非单独提出外部记忆或多问题监督。表8显示Mem-α也使用共享记忆多问题监督。Ledger-QA则以可控账本更新隔离累积状态维护能力，补充传统事实检索评估。[P5–P6、P19]
deep_read.findings: 16k下Generalist在13项基准平均裁判得分75.86；全局分组与分阶段训练分别低5.9、11.2分，支持训练设计的作用。Specialist账本平均Judge为53.02，但500会话时EM仅7.69，表明平均收益并不等于超长状态计算可靠，也非所有指标均领先。[P7、P9、P25]

core.title: In-Place Feedback: Reliable Refinement for Multi-Turn Expert-LLM Collaboration
core.abstract: LLM-generated drafts often contain subtle factual or logical errors, yet prior work shows that models struggle to reliably integrate multi-turn feedback aimed at fixing them. We propose *in-place feedback*, an interaction paradigm in which the user directly edits the model’s previous response and the model continues generation from the edited context. In-place feedback consistently outperforms standard multi-turn feedback across five reasoning-intensive benchmarks while requiring fewer tokens, and our fine-grained analysis shows that it applies corrections more reliably and propagates them to subsequent reasoning. A user study with domain experts refining LLM-generated summaries corroborates these findings: participants report higher final-output satisfaction and substantially lower fatigue with in-place feedback, and a mixed strategy combining in-place and multi-turn feedback improves every dimension we measure. These results suggest that editing errors in place is a more reliable way to incorporate expert corrections than multi-turn feedback, while combining the two acts complementarily to form a more effective collaboration than either mechanism alone.

papers.title: AgentFold: Closed-Loop Agentic Search for Protein Folding Model Design
papers.abstract: Scientific LLM agents have shown promise in literature reasoning, tool use, and experiment planning, but it remains unclear whether they can autonomously improve large, tightly coupled scientific machine-learning systems through executable code changes and computationally expensive validation. We study this question in protein folding, where progress requires coordinated architectural modifications, multi-objective evaluation, and domain-aware interpretation. We present AgentFold, a multi-agent framework that formulates folding-model development as a closed-loop search over executable code variants. Starting from ESMFold, AgentFold proposes hypotheses, implements and debugs code-level modifications, evaluates model variants, analyzes experimental outcomes, and stores both successful and failed interventions in structured memory. An MCTS-style policy allocates computational resources across high-scoring search branches. On an engineering-scale protein-folding codebase comprising more than 2,000 lines of code, AgentFold explores approximately 80 model variants using approximately 5,000 GPU-hours and 170 million LLM tokens. Under a matched computational budget, AgentFold improves the best lDDT by 7.5% over independent Codex proposals and outperforms a random-search control. Beyond model improvement, the resulting intervention traces reveal recurring empirical design patterns: stable gains tend to arise from early, soft, learnable priors and gated refinement, whereas direct geometric perturbations and geometry-conditioned feedback often destabilize training. The code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/lmqfly/AgentFold.
papers.summary: AgentFold研究科学智能体能否通过修改、调试和验证代码，自主改进蛋白折叠模型。系统结合MCTS式搜索、实验记忆和多智能体协作，在紧凑ESMFold衍生模型上探索约80个变体。匹配36次评估时，最佳lDDT达到0.285，高于独立Codex提案的0.265。收益主要集中于局部结构，消融支持IPA偏置与更新门控的互补作用。解读：本文更适合作为闭环科研与模型设计方法案例，而非全局折叠能力突破的证据。[P1–P9]

papers.title: Trip+: Benchmarking Agents in Personalized Interactive Travel Planning
papers.abstract: Interactive travel planning has become a popular use case for language models. Agents are deployed to manage evolving preferences and unexpected disruptions over multiple turns. Such settings require models to make complex, profile-conditioned planning decisions. However, existing benchmarks often evaluate feasibility, personalization, or interaction in relatively isolated settings. We therefore introduce Trip+ to measure the ability of agents to plan travel holistically. In Trip+, given traveler profiles and dynamic interactions, agents must generate and revise minute-level itineraries. End-to-end traveler experiences are evaluated via LLM-based simulators, enabling the assessment of subjective metrics like fatigue. Our scenarios range from simple request resolutions to complex environment-driven replanning. We evaluate 18 LMs and find a consistent gap in experiential quality. Models favor technically feasible but exhausting itineraries that show weaker profile alignment.
papers.summary: Trip+研究旅行规划智能体如何在需求变化与环境扰动中，同时保持行程可执行、画像适配和历史意图一致。基准包含153个多轮实例、570轮交互，结合固定沙箱、状态化规则及体验模拟评价18个模型。结果提示，较高可行性不代表舒适体验，节奏控制与跨轮修订仍是短板；多数指标的领先差异未获显著性支持。[P2][P6][P37]解读：值得作为动态规划代理的评价方法阅读，但旅游疲劳并非结构疲劳或工程可靠性证据。

papers.title: Recontextualizing Famous Quotes for Brand Slogan Generation
papers.abstract: Slogans are concise and memorable catchphrases that play crucial roles in advertising by conveying brand identity and shaping public perception. However, advertising fatigue reduces the effectiveness of repeated slogans, creating a growing demand for novel, creative, and insightful slogan generation. While recent work leverages large language models (LLMs) for this task, existing approaches often generate stylistically repetitive outputs that fall short in distinctiveness and insight.We argue that effective slogans should balance novelty with familiarity and propose a new paradigm that recontextualizes persona-related famous quotes for slogan generation. Well-known quotes naturally align with slogan-length text, employ rich rhetorical devices, and offer depth and insight, making them a powerful resource for creative generation. Technically, we introduce a framework that decomposes slogan generation into interpretable subtasks with a single-pass prompt, including quote matching, structural decomposition, vocabulary replacement, and remix generation. Extensive automatic and human evaluations demonstrate marginal improvements in diversity, emotional impact, and first-glance human preference over three state-of-the-art LLM baselines.

papers.title: LTS-VoiceAgent: A Listen-Think-Speak Framework for Efficient Streaming Voice Interaction via Semantic Triggering and Incremental Reasoning
papers.abstract: Real-time voice agents face a tension: end-to-end models often lack deep reasoning, while cascaded ASR–LLM–TTS pipelines achieve stronger reasoning but defer LLM inference until after ASR finalizes the transcript, creating an avoidable post–turn-end silent gap. We target this gap under complex spoken requests that admit a relatively determinate answer, and treat it as system-induced rather than communicatively motivated. Existing cascaded streaming strategies attempt to reduce it via mechanical segmentation (e.g., fixed chunks, VAD-based splitting) or speculative generation, but they frequently either break semantic units or waste computation on predictions that must be rolled back. We propose LTS-VoiceAgent, a Listen–Think–Speak framework that explicitly separates when to think from how to reason incrementally. It features a Dynamic Semantic Trigger to detect meaningful prefixes, and a Dual-Role Stream Orchestrator that coordinates a background Thinker (for state maintenance) and a foreground Speaker (for speculative solving). This parallel design enables "thinking while listening" without committing audible content before turn end. We also introduce a Pause-and-Repair benchmark that injects natural disfluencies as a semantic-level streaming stress test. Experiments across VERA, Spoken-MQA, BigBenchAudio, and our benchmark show that LTS-VoiceAgent achieves a stronger accuracy–latency–efficiency trade-off than serial cascaded baselines and existing streaming strategies.
papers.summary: 复杂语音请求常使级联系统在用户说完后才开始推理，形成明显等待。本文通过语义触发器判断何时值得计算，并让后台Thinker维护状态、前台Speaker准备答案，将部分推理移入收听阶段。[P3—P5] 四个基准显示其在实时预算下改善质量与效率，8B模型首完整句延迟为332—415毫秒，但并未全面超过完整上下文推理。[P7] 解读：适合作为运维语音助手的架构参考，不是已验证的故障诊断或可靠性方法。

deep_read.method: DistilBERT判断累积转录是否达到语义触发条件，并以阈值和去重过滤无效调用。Thinker维护变量与计划，Speaker并发求解并读取上次已提交状态；新触发抢占旧生成，过时状态丢弃，轮次结束后才提交TTS，避免听见内部回滚。[P4—P5][P13]
deep_read.innovation: 解读：方法贡献主要在于把触发时机与增量推理组织分开，而非首次提出边听边算。作者将学习式语义边界、双角色状态复用和抢占调度组合，并构造含犹豫与自我修正的Pause-and-Repair基准，使输入修订成为显式压力测试。[P6][P12][P19]

papers.title: Learning to Remember: End-to-End Training of Memory Agents for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract: Long-context LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems expand accessible context, but still defer state tracking and evidence consolidation to query time. This passive paradigm is brittle in streaming settings where facts are updated and answers depend on latent states rather than explicit spans. We introduce Unified Memory Agent (UMA), an end-to-end reinforcement-learning framework that trains a single policy to maintain external memory and answer questions. UMA updates a structured memory bank via CRUD operations and combines it with raw-context retrieval for QA. To jointly optimize memory maintenance and question answering, we propose Task-Stratified GRPO, which normalizes heterogeneous trajectories separately for more effective credit assignment. We also introduce Ledger-QA, a controlled benchmark for long-horizon state tracking over accumulated updates. Experiments on Ledger-QA and 13 TTL/AR benchmarks show that UMA improves long-horizon tracking, achieves the best average TTL/AR score among compared methods, and remains competitive on retrieval-centric benchmarks. Our results highlight learned proactive memory management as a complement to longer context windows and query-time retrieval.
papers.summary: 面对持续更新的信息，长上下文模型和RAG往往到提问时才重新整合证据。本文提出统一记忆智能体UMA，在问题揭示前维护结构化记忆，再供多个问答会话复用，并以任务分层GRPO联合训练记忆维护和答案生成。16k预算下，其在13项TTL/AR基准的平均裁判分数领先；账本任务适配进一步改善状态追踪，但超长跨度数值正确性仍弱。[P3–P9、P25]解读：适合作为智能运维状态管理的方法参考，而非直接部署依据。

papers.recommendation: 推荐重点阅读分层信用分配、记忆维护消融和三阶段错误分析，它们可为运维智能体的状态更新与故障归因提供研究思路；但论文没有真实运维任务验证。[P5、P9、P22]

deep_read.problem: 论文研究信息流持续更新时，如何在未知未来问题的条件下保留可复用状态。答案可能来自跨时间累积，而不直接存在于某段原文；逐问检索易重复计算，普通摘要也可能丢失更新细节。核心问题因此是让共享记忆同时服务多个未来目标，而非围绕已知问题压缩上下文。[P1–P3、P6]
deep_read.method: UMA用统一策略处理记忆与问答：逐块维护核心摘要和键值库，通过增删改及读取操作更新状态，问答时结合记忆读取与原文检索。训练采样多条记忆轨迹，以各轨迹下多问答案的平均结果奖励监督记忆，并对记忆会话和逐问题问答组分别归一化优势。[P3–P5]
deep_read.innovation: 创新重点是问题隐藏条件下的共享记忆监督、统一记忆—问答策略与任务分层优势估计的组合，而非单独提出外部记忆或多问题监督。表8显示Mem-α也使用共享记忆多问题监督。Ledger-QA则以可控账本更新隔离累积状态维护能力，补充传统事实检索评估。[P5–P6、P19]
deep_read.findings: 16k下Generalist在13项基准平均裁判得分75.86；全局分组与分阶段训练分别低5.9、11.2分，支持训练设计的作用。Specialist账本平均Judge为53.02，但500会话时EM仅7.69，表明平均收益并不等于超长状态计算可靠，也非所有指标均领先。[P7、P9、P25]
deep_read.limitations: 作者限于单智能体和固定工具接口，真实任务及细粒度操作归因仍待验证。账本各跨度仅3—5个测试样本；EM使用词集合，预处理删除标点会改变数值形式。解读：这些因素限制可靠性外推。逐页记录未确认原文件缺项，已纠正提取错误不能当作公式缺失。[P10、P18、P21–P22]
deep_read.connection: 解读：运维日志、配置变更和维修事件同样需要把分散更新整合为设备当前状态，UMA的主动记忆可作为相关智能体架构参考。其写入、检索和证据使用三阶段失效分类，也便于组织可靠性诊断。不过，论文没有设备故障、结构设计或寿命预测实验，联系仅属方法迁移。[P3、P22]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议构建设备事件流与可核验状态账本，加入重复告警、迟到事件、配置回滚和冲突记录，比较主动记忆、RAG及规则状态机。分别测量写入正确率、状态一致性、诊断证据准确率和多查询摊销成本，并采用保留小数与符号的数值校验；这是后续研究方案，非作者已验证成果。[P10、P21–P22]

papers.title: In-Place Feedback: Reliable Refinement for Multi-Turn Expert-LLM Collaboration
papers.abstract: LLM-generated drafts often contain subtle factual or logical errors, yet prior work shows that models struggle to reliably integrate multi-turn feedback aimed at fixing them. We propose *in-place feedback*, an interaction paradigm in which the user directly edits the model’s previous response and the model continues generation from the edited context. In-place feedback consistently outperforms standard multi-turn feedback across five reasoning-intensive benchmarks while requiring fewer tokens, and our fine-grained analysis shows that it applies corrections more reliably and propagates them to subsequent reasoning. A user study with domain experts refining LLM-generated summaries corroborates these findings: participants report higher final-output satisfaction and substantially lower fatigue with in-place feedback, and a mixed strategy combining in-place and multi-turn feedback improves every dimension we measure. These results suggest that editing errors in place is a more reliable way to incorporate expert corrections than multi-turn feedback, while combining the two acts complementarily to form a more effective collaboration than either mechanism alone.
papers.summary: 专家纠正模型错误后，模型为何仍会重复错误或破坏正确内容？本文将反馈从追加指令改为直接编辑旧回答、剪除依赖内容并续写，通过五项基准、逐轮诊断及15人用户研究检验效果。[P4–P9]作者报告准确率、令牌效率和主观体验总体改善，混合模式评分最高。但部分模型与指标存在例外，案例续写也残留公式错误。[P23、P35–P36]解读：值得作为人机纠错机制研究阅读，不能直接视为工程可靠性方法。
papers.method: 基于原文摘要的规则摘要
papers.recommendation: 推荐重点阅读定位与续写消融、反馈接纳和纠错传播指标，以及不完整反馈实验；它们为专家参与的模型纠错提供可复用设计，但与结构疲劳可靠性仅有间接联系。[P6–P8、P18]

deep_read.problem: 论文关注专家反复纠错时，模型仍破坏正确内容、忽略反馈或引入后续错误的问题。[P2–P3]作者假设错误上下文累积和反馈定位负担阻碍修订；研究重点是协作过程能否可靠吸收纠正，而非仅衡量一次回答的正确率。该机制归因仍属假设。
deep_read.method: 原位反馈先直接替换错误片段，再删除依赖它的推理，从修正上下文续写；ZebraLogic保留独立有效步骤。[P4、P14]实验以反馈代理和编辑代理模拟专家，对比完整历史多轮与最近三条反馈的记忆基线，并通过局部编辑但保留历史的消融分离作用。[P6]
deep_read.innovation: 作者将局部编辑从界面操作推进到模型实际条件上下文，不额外训练模型，也不要求每轮整段重生成。[P19–P20]同时用CPR、FAR、CTRR分别衡量正确内容保持、显式反馈接纳及未被点名错误的修复。[P7]解读：贡献主要在交互机制与诊断框架，而非新模型架构。
deep_read.findings: 表1中Qwen在MATH-hard末轮累计准确率由多轮0.862提高到原位0.928。[P6]用户研究报告混合模式五项评分最高。[P9]但大型Llama的top-2网格准确率原位0.475低于多轮0.492。[P23]因此证据支持总体收益，不支持所有条件下全面领先。
deep_read.limitations:
仅15人摘要研究，大型逻辑实验五轮单种子，外推有限。[P10、P22]原文件缺项须保留：P17图D.7缺CTRR面板，无法核对其趋势；P32等价规则缺房屋编号，复现含糊。P35–P36续写仍有公式问题，不能据最终答案确认推理可靠。
原文核对：[P17] 图D.7原页图注写“CPR, FAR, and CTRR”，实际图中仅有CPR、FAR两排，没有CTRR面板或数值。属于图注与所示指标不一致，不能据此报告Oracle反馈下的CTRR趋势，也不能推造缺失结果。其余图文清楚，不影响页面识读及对已展示CPR、FAR的核对。；[P32] 图I.8的Equivalence normalization第一条在原页写为“‘name’ of house i is X ↔ X is in House”，右侧House后缺少房屋编号；并非提取遗漏。该等价示例未完整指定对应房屋，可能使复现时的等价识别规则不明确，但不能仅凭此断言实验实现有误或量化其影响。其余提示词及图注可读。
deep_read.connection: 解读：对智能运维，局部纠错与依赖剪枝可启发告警解释、诊断报告的专家修订；对结构设计，可借鉴保留已核验约束的交互方式。[P14、P32]但本文可靠性指反馈整合，疲劳指用户负担，不是材料疲劳寿命或结构失效概率，尚无这些领域的验证。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议以工程诊断或设计审核构建有标准约束的对照任务，比较多轮、原位和混合模式，同时记录误改率、纠错传播、复核时间及辅助代理总成本。[P7、P9、P21]另需多种子、长期用户研究，并独立检查公式与单位，避免满意度或最终答案掩盖中间错误。[P35–P36]
